pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit high edge angularity with sharp pixel gradients; geometries are irregularly polygonal and jagged, resembling serrated rhomboids and complex triangles; spatial area of patches is large relative to the intervening light pelage.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological graph; junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial; pixel thickness of the pathways is narrow and uniform across the mid-flank, widening at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D geometric contour against the blurred background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Two localized, dark, elevated circular nodules showing hyper-pigmentation and textural disruption are visible on the lateral-dorsal transition of the neck.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark, raised nodular anomaly is present on the lower ventral-lateral region of the neck near the chest.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark-toned avian organism (oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal midline of the animal's rump.
